questions.title: Which European country will announce a complete drought-related shutdown of its nuclear power generation between August 1 and August 13, 2026?
questions.background: Nuclear reactors require reliable cooling-water supplies. Low river levels can force reactors to shut down, potentially disrupting national electricity supplies.
questions.resolution_criteria: Source of Truth : Official announcements by national nuclear operators or governments, corroborated by reliable news reporting. Resolution Conditions : Identify the European country that announces, between August 1 and August 13, 2026, a shutdown covering its entire operating nuclear fleet because drought has left insufficient river water for cooling. An announcement initiating the shutdown of the last operating reactor qualifies; a partial shutdown alone does not. Accepted Answer Format : The country's common English name.

(2) Romania rises to co-favorite (0.29 -> 0.34): with Cernavoda Unit 1 offline and Unit 2 (literally its last operating reactor) fluctuating under critical hour-by-hour restrictions, PM Ilie Bolojan declared a nationwide state of emergency for all of August on July 31 and approved emergency funds for canal water diversion to keep Unit 2 running — carrying Unit 2 past July 31 directly into the Aug 1-13 window while Danube inflow drops toward 1,500 m3/s by Aug 4. (3) Bulgaria rises (0.23 -> 0.26): while Kozloduy Units 5 & 6 stayed on schedule via Serbian Iron Gate (Djerdap) dam releases, NEI July 31 reports Bulgaria classified the crisis as force majeure with the Danube still dropping up to 2 cm/day and deployed emergency dredging and secondary pumps, creating substantial Aug 5-13 risk if upstream buffers exhaust. local_articles.title: Hungary nuclear plant shuts due to Danube drought
local_articles.snippet: hutting down its sole nuclear power plant for the first time due to the record low levels of the Danube River, straining energy supplies and posing a major test for the economy and new Prime Minister Peter Magyar. One of the two reactors still operating at the Paks plant was shut down early on Aug 2, with the final one powering down later in the day, according to Magyar. He cited the progressively lower water levels, which are causing a shortage of water for cooling at the facility, which is operating at a little over a tenth of its 2,000 megawatt capacity. The nation is heading into uncharted territory by shutting the nuclear plant for the first time in its 44-year history – a result of sustained drought across much of central Europe. local_articles.title: Lionel Messi returns as Inter Miami draw 2-2 against Columbus Crew
local_articles.snippet: MIAMI – Lionel Messi returned to Major League Soccer action after World Cup duty on Aug 1, coming on in the second half as his Inter Miami side drew 2-2 with Columbus Crew. Two weeks after Argentina’s loss to Spain in the World Cup final, Messi was back on the pitch, entering in the 53rd minute to the delight of fans at Miami’s Nu Stadium. But the 39-year-old could not mark his return with a goal, twice shooting wide. Uruguayan Luis Suarez scored his seventh goal in his last four games to put Miami 1-0 up in the 16th minute. Miami’s former Manchester United and Real Madrid midfielder Casemiro scored an own goal in the 34th minute which helped Columbus draw level at 1-1. local_articles.title: Philadelphia Union rally from two goals down to beat Atlanta United 3-2
local_articles.snippet: Ezekiel Alladoh scored the winner in the 97th minute, one minute after Neil Pierre equalized the match, as the Philadelphia Union rallied from two goals down to beat Atlanta United 3-2 on Saturday in stoppage time. Pierre headed in a pass from Kai Wagner in the 96th minute to equalize before Alladoh finished with his left foot from the center of the box off another Wagner assist in the 97th to seal the win for Philadelphia. Philadelphia scored three unanswered goals after falling behind 2-0 despite playing with a man advantage for more than an hour. Atlanta went down to 10 men in the 27th minute when Enea Mihaj was shown a red card, but Miguel Almirón gave United the lead three minutes later.
